answer.summary: The API Types Check failed because the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. The change added new enum values (SOURCE_CODE, CODE_REPOSITORY, CI_CD_PIPELINE, PACKAGE_REGISTRY, SOFTWARE_PACKAGE, CODE_OTHER) to the API, and regenerating the types produces a diff that was not committed. This is deterministic and will repeat on re-run. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the updated api-types.d.ts.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
